title: Cover malformed revision metadata combined with owner identity in runtime-observation census
outcome: The runtime-observation census rejects malformed source_revision metadata even when source_id has a valid shape, with a behavioral regression that distinguishes this guard from missing-owner rejection.
acceptance: Classifier behavior tests combine source_revision 42 and null with a valid source_id and require Unknown; an empty-string revision plus a valid source_id requires SourceId.
The tests fail if revision type validation is bypassed while source_id validation remains correct; failure assertions expose only bounded fixed text or fixed enum/counter results.
Focused relevant validation passes and the review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher findings.
